page.layout: One scan: the front cover of a bound book, dark red leather with worn, rubbed edges. No printed block, no text.
page.notes: Scan shows the outside of the binding (red leather boards with wear, staining and exposed edges along the spine and corners), not a printed leaf. No printed words, numbers, running heads, signatures or catchwords are visible, so nothing is transcribed. The text of the book is on the leaves that follow.
